title: Grimoire colour theme
description: A set of colour tokens overriding Grimoire's palette. A theme may pair a light and a dark palette so one entry covers System mode. Themes are data, never executed, and are installed per user rather than server-wide.

id.description: Stable identifier. Must match the theme's directory name.

mode.description: Which built-in palette this theme is a variation of. Grimoire uses it for anything the theme does not override.

app_mode.description: Which app mode the theme was designed for. A preference the picker sorts by, not a restriction — a theme can be used in either. Defaults to grimoire.

tokens.description: Colour tokens. Only the names listed here are recognised — Grimoire drops anything else, and any value that is not a plain colour. Every token is optional: unset ones fall back to the built-in palette for `mode`.

^(bg-deep|bg-panel|bg-card|bg-card-hover.description: A plain colour: hex, rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), or a keyword. Anything else is rejected — a token value goes straight into a stylesheet.

variants.description: A light and/or dark palette in one theme, so a single entry covers System mode. Takes precedence over `tokens` when present; a theme may ship either shape, and one shipping only one mode still applies in the other.

light.description: One colour mode's token set. Same rules as `tokens`.

^(bg-deep|bg-panel|bg-card|bg-card-hover.description: A plain colour: hex, rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), or a keyword. Anything else is rejected — a token value goes straight into a stylesheet.

dark.description: One colour mode's token set. Same rules as `tokens`.

^(bg-deep|bg-panel|bg-card|bg-card-hover.description: A plain colour: hex, rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), or a keyword. Anything else is rejected — a token value goes straight into a stylesheet.
